open_questions: Original pipeline flagged as false alarm scenario per similar neighbours; shape v_sigma -1.458 formally flat-bottomed but with b 0.9606 grazing and density penalty 783, per transit inspection needed
dossier.public_summary: A period of about 3.04 days appears both as a transit and as the star's own 3-day spot rotation with huge spot flickering about 16,000 ppm, and the measured transit depth jumps from ~1200 ppm to near zero between sectors and between individual transits. An on-target centroid rules out a nearby blended binary, but the varying depths, depth outliers, and phase-curve variation at the same period match a star's own variability / activity harmonic, not a stable planet.

reasons.why: Depth changes dramatically between sectors including one negative measurement at -531 +/- 309 ppm; depth is not steady even within the same pipeline, inconsistent with a single planet depth on the target.
